data: How about we each catch 10 tons this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons to double back to 100 next month. If we stick to that limit, we can keep earning that amount every month. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that the agreement is working and discuss any problems. Are you all willing to commit? John, what do you think?
I’m in, Luke—I'll catch 10 tons, provided we all agree to that limit. Keeping the lake replenished protects everyone’s future income. John, are you on board?
I’m on board with 10 tons each. If anyone exceeds the limit, let’s agree on lower catches the following month to rebuild the stock rather than risk draining the lake. John, can you commit too?
I’ll commit to 10 tons. If the stock falls below 100 tons, let’s agree on whole-ton limits before fishing again so we leave enough to rebuild. Jack, are you willing to join us at 10 tons this month?
Count me in—I’ll catch 10 tons this month. That makes all five of us agreed. Let’s check the reported catches afterward and adjust together if the lake needs rebuilding.
